# Bundled front-end libraries

Served by the app itself under `web/vendor/`, so the page needs no internet access for its own UI.

| Library | Version | Licence | Source |
|---------|---------|---------|--------|
| Leaflet | 1.9.4 | BSD-2-Clause (see `leaflet/LICENSE`) | https://leafletjs.com / `leaflet@1.9.4/dist` |

Files are unmodified copies of the published `dist` build (the same copy Meldkamer bundles).
